en.s: The New Democratic Party won the November 2025 election and Godwin Friday became prime minister. Saying it inherited debt of 113% of GDP, the government set three pillars (fiscal stability, debt restructuring and private-investment-led growth) and new fiscal rules. It joined the development bank CAF to refinance on cheaper terms and announced a roughly US$50 million desalination and water-storage project backed by the Green Climate Fund.

en.s: After Maduro was removed by a US operation in January 2026, Acting President Delcy Rodríguez is opening the oil sector and improving ties with the US. en.s: The FAST party won the August 2025 snap election and La'auli Leuatea Schmidt became prime minister. The 2025/26 budget of ST$1.24 billion projects a deficit of over ST$200 million, resets the district development programme and aims to reduce reliance on seasonal labour schemes while building local agriculture. In March 2026 the World Bank approved US$35 million for early warning and resilient infrastructure at Salelologa on Savai'i, and a new national plan (PDS 2026/27–2030/31) was launched.

en.s: Re-elected President Hichilema's government is preparing the 2027 budget framework (approved by Cabinet on Sep 17, 2026) under the Grow Zambia agenda, with 2027 resources projected to rise 7.4%. Copper expansion (3 million tonnes by 2031), more power and logistics, and a new IMF programme are central.
en.ld: President Hakainde Hichilema (re-elected Aug 2026, second term from Sep 2026)
ag: Grow Zambia: jobs, single-digit inflation and exchange rate stability
Copper output from about 890,000 tonnes (2025) to 3 million tonnes by 2031, with more local processing
More power supply (at least 2,000 MW extra needed for copper growth) and better logistics
nd: Equipment, processing and logistics investment for copper and critical minerals
Generation capacity (2,000 MW or more) and transmission and distribution
Road and border infrastructure design and supervision capacity (World Bank and MCC projects)
Digital tax and e-procurement systems to widen the tax base (estimate)
bz: PMO and project management consulting for road and border infrastructure
Digital irrigation monitoring and water management system
Digital registration and production-reporting platform for small-scale and artisanal miners
Spending efficiency and performance budgeting consulting for 2027

en.s: Finance Minister Mthuli Ncube set a 2027 growth target of 3.5% and a deficit below 3% of GDP. Revenue exceeded spending in January-September 2026, and the budget follows the second National Development Strategy (NDS2) and Vision 2030, focusing on infrastructure, housing, agriculture and digital transformation.
